question: Which is the correct formula to calculate the formula unit mass of a compound?

options.text: Multiplication of all the atomic masses of all the atoms within the formula
Summation of all the atomic weights of all the atoms within the formula
Summation of all the atomic masses of all the atoms within the formula
Multiplication of all the atomic weights of all the atoms within the formula

solution:
The correct answer is __**Summation of all the atomic masses of all the atoms within the formula**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Changing the kinetic energy in the particles of the matter: Kinetic energy is directly related to the temperature of a substance, and changes in kinetic energy can lead to changes in the state of matter (e.g., from solid to liquid or liquid to gas).
 
• Changing the temperature of the matter: Temperature changes can cause matter to change its state.
